diagnosis: R15 early perturbed point RMSE was 0.615 mm, but one-normal-per-hidden-perturbation affine mass calibration produced a 3.409 mm LOO guard and 0/12 substantial actions. The target is conditional normal prediction, not a lower acceptance threshold.

public_estimator.structure: A single pooled stock+perturbed normal calibration. Before grasp, fit an empty-arm stiffness residual and encoder tracking projections onto taught viscous and regularized-Coulomb motion. During carriage, jointly solve three COM moments, one stiffness coordinate, six JTS DC terms and six linear drifts. Both the residual bias and normal absolute-COM expectation are affine in interpolated mass and the measured pregrasp signature; no fixture label or perturbation setting is an input.
public_estimator.uncertainty: 0.75 mm physical margin plus fully refitted leave-one-normal-out 2-D error plus largest five contiguous carried-time block deletion distance. Keep the existing radius <=2.5 mm, norm > radius and 15 mm vector cap. Require mass interpolation and a measured-signature standardized radius no larger than the greatest source-normal radius; this uses no hidden domain label.
public_estimator.assumptions: The source-normal envelope spans the deployment stiffness/drag signatures; pickup perturbations are constant within an episode; no unmodeled pregrasp contact occurs in 0.3--0.9 s; accepted COM moment columns remain identifiable after DC/drift/stiffness nuisance projection. Poor support or observability forces zero action.

calibration: Existing exposed normal-only stock and perturbed records are development calibration, not acceptance evidence. Test truths and offset labels are never consumed by fit or prediction.
sensing_gates: Separately for stock and perturbed: vector RMSE <=1.5 mm; zero-on-abstain max action error <=2 mm; no accepted interval miss; no action for truth norm <1 mm; every truth norm >=3 mm accepted with positive dot. All 20 rows count. Predictions and source hashes are sealed before truth opens.
control_gate: Only a domain passing every sensing gate may enter a separately reported control comparison. Require zero fallback parity and original R15 G4/cost/saturation/FA/tool gates; otherwise stop at bounded sensing evidence.
scope: Simulation-only research; no release, kit, core controller, detector, evaluator, manifest, hardware, dependency, remote or GitHub changes.
